description: Combine the current register-resident n=32/n=64 full-stack winner with the validated 2-CTA SM100 CuTe triangular RankK and in-place TRSM large-shape path. Preserve n=128 and direct cuSOLVER crossovers, resolve extension/build conflicts minimally, validate all guards, and retune dispatch so each shape keeps its measured fastest implementation.

Merged the register-resident n=32/n=64 and established n=128 kernels with batch-one direct in-place cuBLAS STRSM and the 2-CTA SM100 CuTe lower-triangular RankK path. Build, all 17 official validations, and the fresh-seed guard passed. Small cells measured 22.848/31.497/97.280 us; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4978.861/15618.229/56479.499 us; full geomean improved from the 1184.177 us first parent to 1169.558 us.

Computed the merged dispatch before shape-state setup and skipped unused cuSOLVER info/workspace plus pointer arrays on mixed CuTe shapes. Build, official validation, fresh-seed guard, and benchmark passed. The selected paths remained unchanged; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4976.538/15655.040/56967.040 us and full geomean measured 1172.674 us versus 1169.558 us for the exact merge.

Raised the merged batch-one CuTe crossover from n=8192 to n=16384, leaving n=8192 on direct BF16x9 cuSOLVER while retaining all custom small paths. All validation and guards passed. Direct n=8192 measured 6021.289 us versus 4976.538 us on CuTe in the prior trial; full geomean rose from 1172.674 to 1176.588 us.

Lowered only the batch-one mixed/CuTe crossover to n=4096 while keeping batch-two n=4096 on direct cuSOLVER. Build, all official tests, guard, and benchmark passed. The one-panel batch-one n=4096 path measured 1669.412 us versus 1430-1436 us direct; full geomean measured 1185.782 us, while n>=8192 retained the CuTe path.

Restored the exact trial-0 merged implementation after bracketing the crossover: direct cuSOLVER through n=4096 and 2-CTA CuTe from n=8192, with original solver-state setup. Build, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guard, and benchmark passed. This repeat measured 1173.387 us; the byte-identical trial-0 sample remains the brief best at 1169.558 us.

Best measured commit ec6ece7 reached 1169.558 us, 1.23% below the 1184.177 us register-small parent and 45.70% below the 2153.690 us baseline. It combines register-resident n=32/n=64, the established n=128 kernel, direct BF16x9 cuSOLVER through n=4096, high-batch FP16 updates, and batch-one in-place STRSM plus 2-CTA SM100 CuTe triangular RankK from n=8192. All builds, 17 official tests, fresh-seed guards, and full 15-shape benchmarks passed. Exact integration measured 1169.558; pruning unused mixed-shape solver state measured 1172.674; raising the CuTe threshold exposed direct n=8192 at 6021.289 versus about 4977 us CuTe and scored 1176.588; lowering only batch-one threshold exposed n=4096 blocked at 1669.412 versus about 1433 us direct and scored 1185.782; restoring byte-identical selected code remeasured 1173.387. Local profiling remained waived. Keep this combined line moving with repeated samples to resolve the 0.33% state-pruning spread, a lazy/shape-scoped CuTe compile and operation cache, FP32-to-FP16 conversion fused into the CuTe mainloop, or a shared output/panel cache that avoids unused large mixed state without perturbing direct shapes.
